messages:
Carla: Thanks everyone for joining today — quick follow-up thread for the Qs we didn’t finish in the live Q&A. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/allhands/mar-2026 :wave:
Priya: Quick ask — Dedicated GA timeline? heard end of Q2 during the talk but wanted confirmation for planning integrations.
Carla: End of Q2 is the current target. There are a couple infra blockers we’re tracking; if anything slips we’ll notify by Apr 5. Owner for infra blockers: @Dylan. :calendar:
Dylan: I’ll take infra blockers and publish an "infra playbook" with mitigation steps. ETA: EOW. Will include rollback/capacity knobs.
Ana: I'll draft the runbook and sample config snippets for Private and Dedicated flows. Expect a first pass by Mon.
Mike: For the SLA question — are we locking down the SLO numbers before GA? Legal needs a concrete target to include in proposals.
Ben: I’ll own the SLA write-up (legal). Draft in #legal by Thu. We should aim for a clear uptime number + maintenance window policy.
Priya: Private preview region plan: us-west-2 + eu-west-1 initially; ap-southeast-1 if partner pilot signs. I’ll share invite cadence and quota rules. Owner: @Priya.
Dylan: Rollout plan: canary in us-west-2, expand to eu after 48h if metrics stable. Will post the canary checklist as a gist.
Mike: Request from support: short "known limitations" list for GA (quantization caveats, KV cache warmup, max seq length behaviors). Helps set expectations.
Ana: I’ll assemble a one-page FAQ for support and sales, then add it to the docs repo. Link here once uploaded.
Carla: Action items recap (short):
- @Dylan: infra playbook + canary checklist (EOW)
- @Ana: runbook + sample configs (Mon)
- @Ben: SLA draft (Thu)
- @Priya: region roster + preview invites (in progress)
I’ll do a quick status post on Fri. Please ping me if anything blocks your owners. :tada:
deploy-bot: Deployment notice — canary environment created in staging at 2026-03-27 09:12 UTC.
Mike: Acknowledged, will monitor logs/alerts during canary window.
Priya: I’ll update the roadmap page and post the invite spreadsheet here when ready.
Carla: Thanks all — this thread is the single source for these follow-ups. If you add new owners, please @mention in-thread so I can track.
